scope: Actual monitor and output controller with controlled render-quantum lag and asynchronous sink. Proves commanded UI state and ownership, not rendered PCM, native OS sink or physical sockets.

checks.name: Mute status follows accepted target while AudioParam.value still reports the previous render quantum
A rejected gain schedule cannot falsely change the reported mute target
Completed stopped selection clears pending and stale MUTED status without context resume or deck Play
Selection rejection clears pending and preserves the observed error without claiming completion
Disposal during actual sink selection cannot reopen the graph or emit late callbacks
